calm, steady news narration with natural emphasis at key points and turns; not dramatic.
Speak at a slightly slower, relaxed pace than natural adult narration, while keeping the delivery smooth, conversational, and natural. Do not exaggerate pauses or sound instructional.
asr_text: I don't want people to stop me using social media just because of my age. If even high school students couldn't have accounts, it would be hard to keep in touch with friends. I'm against the ban. I want a say in what I can use and how I use it. I want to decide for myself, but I can't handle everything that happens on my own. If people say bad things about me or threaten me, I'd still want to go to an adult right away. Maybe that's selfish of me. Instead of giving everyone the same limits because of their age, I think we can do other things, like set safety filters. I want the way we deal with this to fit how we use it, but we should still be able to keep in touch with friends.
